description: This script tests the handling of UTF-16 encoded files without BOM in a Perforce & Git integration environment, involving starting a Perforce server, creating a UTF-16 file, modifying it, and cloning a depot with assertions on file correctness.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce depot with specified type.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4d -jc
methods.description: Creates a checkpoint of the server.

methods.name: p4d -jrF
methods.description: Restores a server from a checkpoint.
